name: ob1-mcp-server
comment: The brain's MCP server as a client of its REST core (SMD-2287): MCP over streamable HTTP on SDK v2, every tool a call to the REST core through ../rest-client with the caller's key forwarded beside this server's forward-scope key, every answer worded by ../server-portable/render.ts, and the endpoint's HTTP edge server-portable's own (../server-portable/mcp-edge.ts). The MCP packages, hono and zod are pinned at server-portable's versions, so a tool's schema (server-portable/core/schemas.ts) and the SDK that validates it agree; the type pins move with server-portable's (check 18).
